summary: Witness B's account is consistent with the record. She says she was waiting at the store on the corner and watched the car come over the crest and into the side of the turning truck, and NTSB reports the crest as the only sight restriction with up to 10.4 s of visibility. Her exact position cannot be determined from the transcript.

findings.summary: Witness B had a clear view of the car as it approached; nothing in the record contradicts her.

evidence.citation: [27:46] "I had a clear view of the car the whole way in. I watched it right up until the moment it hit. Nothing was in the way."

findings.summary: Witness B marked her position on Exhibit 4, but the transcript records only "over by the corner, near the shelter"; position cannot be verified.

evidence.citation: [27:04] "I was over by the corner, near the shelter."

findings.summary: Witness A says the trailer blocked his view once the truck crossed; consistent with NTSB.

missed: Text-only: never sees WHERE she marked on Exhibit 4, and never builds the scene, so it cannot notice that the turning truck itself sits between her and the car in the final seconds.
